description: Transform your new tab into a serene sanctuary of Bhagavad Gita wisdom: all 701 verses in Sanskrit with transliteration and a public-domain English translation, text-to-speech reading, and customizable themes.

cwsListing.shortDescription: The complete Bhagavad Gita on your new tab: all 701 verses in Sanskrit with transliteration and a public-domain English translation.
cwsListing.detailedDescription: Transform your new tab into a serene sanctuary of Bhagavad Gita wisdom: all 701 verses in Sanskrit with transliteration and a public-domain English translation, text-to-speech reading, and customizable themes.
cwsListing.singlePurpose: Replaces the new tab page with a dashboard that shows Bhagavad Gita verses in Sanskrit with transliteration, an English translation and text-to-speech reading.

permissionJustifications.storage: Stores the user's theme, preferred language, text-to-speech voice settings, bookmarked verses, reading-streak stats and cached machine translations locally in chrome.storage.local so they persist across new tabs and sessions.

cwsListing.remoteCodeJustification: The extension does not use remote code. All JavaScript is packaged in the extension; it only loads Google Fonts stylesheets and fetches JSON translation data from the Google Translate endpoint, neither of which is executed as code.
